statusDetail: Coverage-complete report-mode audit across seven representative read-only paths. Payments, registration completion, message sending, and ad publication were not executed because they require credentials or create consequential external state.

page.framework: Server-rendered legacy HTML with imperative JavaScript
page.notes: Latvian mobile classifieds marketplace. Representative archetypes: home, section, results, listing detail, login, ad-posting entry, and invalid-route recovery.

paths.description: Homepage/category index, global shell, consent, preferences, performance, security, and memory.
Transport section representing section/index navigation and filters.
Audi result list representing dense classifieds results, filtering, sorting, and pagination.
Vehicle listing detail representing media, commercial metadata, and contact actions.
Authentication form representing account access and input assistance.
Ad-posting entry representing the seller journey without publishing external state.
Guaranteed-invalid route used to test HTTP status and recovery behavior.

findings.summary: The site is fixed to a light theme.
findings.evidence: The dark-mode screenshot is pixel-identical to the normal mobile capture, and the DOM reports color-scheme: normal with a white body.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare light/dark support at the root and retint surfaces with color-scheme and light-dark() or prefers-color-scheme.

findings.summary: Motion is not adapted for reduced-motion users.
findings.evidence: Normal and prefers-reduced-motion menu videos retain the same scripted transition behavior; the page exposes no reduced-motion adaptation.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap non-essential transitions in a no-preference query and remove or shorten them under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: Route and menu state changes are abrupt and have no View Transition treatment.
findings.evidence: The recorded menu interaction and route walkthrough show immediate state/page swaps; probes found no view-transition usage.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document View Transitions for menu/state changes and progressive cross-document transitions for catalog navigation.

findings.summary: Long catalog pages provide static chrome but no scroll-position feedback.
findings.evidence: The results page is 2,785px tall; its mobile capture and probe show a fixed visual header but no progress indicator or scroll-state-responsive treatment.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight scroll-state affordance, such as a shrinking header or progress/position cue, without main-thread scroll handlers.

findings.summary: Navigation changes do not clearly cue where context moved.
findings.evidence: The home, category, results, and detail captures swap content without directional transition or semantic heading landmarks; probes report no headings.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve and announce route context with a real page heading, breadcrumbs where useful, and a subtle directional View Transition.

findings.summary: The consent panel obscures a large share of every first view.
findings.evidence: Fresh-profile screenshots show the fixed consent panel covering roughly the lower 38% of the 390x844 viewport, including listing and detail content.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, non-obscuring consent notice with equally clear choices and reserve modal treatment only when legally necessary.

findings.summary: The blocking consent surface is an ad-hoc fixed div rather than a semantic dialog.
findings.evidence: DOM evidence shows #cookie_confirm_dv as a fixed div; probes report zero dialog/popover elements and inline onclick handlers.
findings.suggestedFix: Model the consent decision as a labelled dialog when modal, with native focus management and explicit close/choice semantics.

findings.summary: The layout only stretches globally rather than adapting components to available space.
findings.evidence: 390px and 1440px captures show the same single-column catalog stretched across the viewport; probes found no container-query support.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce component-level breakpoints with container queries so catalog rows and detail media gain intentional wide layouts.

findings.summary: Many controls are too short for comfortable touch use.
findings.evidence: Across probes, selects and actions are 25-36px high; every visible detail action was below 44px and the results page had 14 undersized targets.
findings.suggestedFix: Give interactive targets a minimum 44px hit area while retaining visible keyboard focus and non-hover affordances.

findings.summary: Invalid routes silently return the homepage with HTTP 200.
findings.evidence: The invented /lv/this-route-does-not-exist-web-uplift/ path returned responseStatus 200 and ordinary homepage content with no not-found message or recovery explanation.
findings.suggestedFix: Return a real 404 status and an explicit not-found state with search, back, and category recovery actions.

findings.summary: Analytics scripts dominate an otherwise small page load.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 511,629 transferred bytes; two Google tag scripts plus analytics account for about 326KB, while third parties total 461,058 bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate analytics tags, load only after the relevant consent, and remove duplicate/legacy measurement clients.

findings.summary: Core images and controls lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports image-alt and link-name failures; the image primitive found 17 of 19 images without alt, including logo/menu/category imagery.
findings.suggestedFix: Add appropriate alt text or empty alt for decorative images, and accessible names/roles for icon-only controls and links.

findings.summary: Pages have no semantic heading or landmark structure.
findings.evidence: All six page probes report zero headings and zero main/nav/header/footer landmarks, despite long category, result, and detail content.
findings.suggestedFix: Use one descriptive h1 per page and semantic header, nav, main, and footer landmarks in reading order.

findings.summary: Dense listing and footer text reduces reading comfort.
findings.evidence: The mobile results capture compresses description, price, year, engine, and mileage into a dense row; probes show 15px-high footer links.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase line-height and spacing, establish a resilient text measure, and separate key listing facts without shrinking links.

findings.summary: Mobile zoom is explicitly disabled.
findings.evidence: The viewport is user-scalable=0 and Lighthouse fails meta-viewport; multiple controls are also below 44px.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove user-scalable=0, allow pinch zoom, and keep the layout reflowable at high zoom.

findings.summary: Document markup and image delivery rely on obsolete patterns.
findings.evidence: DOM contains presentational table/align/border attributes and inline handlers; image evidence shows 16 legacy-format assets and five below-fold images loaded eagerly.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace presentational attributes with structured HTML/CSS and modernize image formats/loading while preserving dimensions.

findings.summary: The page is excluded from the back/forward cache.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports Cache-Control: no-store on the main resource and cookie-modifying requests as BFCache blockers.
findings.suggestedFix: Narrow no-store to genuinely sensitive responses and avoid mutating session state during ordinary read-only navigations.

findings.summary: Public pages have no meta description.
findings.evidence: Home, category, results, detail, login, and new-ad probes all report metaDescription: null; Lighthouse fails meta-description.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a unique, concise description for each public archetype based on its visible content.

findings.summary: Listing details lack structured data and social preview metadata.
findings.evidence: The public vehicle detail probe reports no JSON-LD and no Open Graph tags despite exposing product-like price, model, location, and images.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate schema.org Product/Vehicle or Offer JSON-LD and Open Graph metadata matching the visible listing.

findings.summary: Important browser security headers are missing.
findings.evidence: Headers evidence confirms HTTPS and HSTS, but no CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP, nosniff, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, and a restrictive Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Tracking loads while the consent decision is still blocking the page.
findings.evidence: A fresh-profile HAR captured Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, DoubleClick, Puls, and Europuls while the consent overlay remained visible; 27 of 34 requests and 461KB were third-party.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not initialize optional analytics until explicit opt-in; minimize vendors and batch only necessary events.

findings.summary: Authentication is password-only and lacks modern credential support.
findings.evidence: The login probe exposes only text/password fields with no autocomplete tokens or passkey/WebAuthn affordance; no permission prompt occurred on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Add passkey registration/sign-in with password fallback and correct username/current-password autocomplete tokens.

findings.summary: The app-like mobile site is not installable and has no offline fallback.
findings.evidence: The page declares apple-mobile-web-app-capable and links native apps, but all probes report no manifest and no controlling service worker.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a web app manifest and a small service-worker offline fallback for saved/catalog shell navigation.

findings.summary: Localized variants lack explicit alternate-language and bidi-ready signals.
findings.evidence: Pages correctly use lang=lv, but expose no hreflang links and no dir attribute; authored markup repeatedly uses physical left/right alignment and margins.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish hreflang alternates, set dir consistently, and replace physical positioning with logical properties.

findings.summary: Consent choices are visually asymmetric and rejection is not direct.
findings.evidence: The panel emphasizes a filled green “Allow all” action while “Choose” is outlined; there is no equally direct reject-all choice and content remains obscured.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer Accept all, Reject all, and Customize with equal prominence and preserve the decision without nagging.

findings.summary: Sign-in fields do not expose native validation or associated labels.
findings.evidence: Login fields have no required, aria-invalid, or associated label values; the visible captions are not programmatically connected.
findings.suggestedFix: Associate labels, mark required fields, validate after interaction, and announce concise errors in an aria-live summary.

findings.summary: Sign-in inputs omit autocomplete assistance.
findings.evidence: The login probe reports empty autocomplete values for both login and password fields.
findings.suggestedFix: Use autocomplete=username and autocomplete=current-password, and support WebAuthn conditional mediation where available.

findings.summary: Image delivery is not responsive or deferred.
findings.evidence: Home uses 16 PNG/GIF assets and eagerly loads five below-fold images; detail loads 910px JPEGs and many thumbnails without srcset or lazy loading.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve AVIF/WebP responsive sources, lazy-load offscreen images, and select sizes appropriate to the rendered width.
